items.title: Lockheed Martin Fast-Tracks Secret Missile as Global Weapons Demand Rises
items.summary: Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) has unveiled the AIM-260 Joint Advanced Tactical Missile (JATM), a classified next-generation air-to-air weapon designed to provide greater range and effectiveness against advanced threats such as China’s J-20 fighter. items.title: Lockheed wins US Army missile contract worth up to $1.2 billion
items.summary: Sept 21 (Reuters) - Lockheed Martin said on Monday it had secured a contract worth up to $1.2 billion from the US Army to produce the Increment 2 variant of the Precision Strike Missile (PrSM).
